title: Fourth Sister
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: Blindly loyal to Darth Vader and the Inquisitorius, The Fourth Sister was present during the hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi on Daiyu. After the apparent death of the Grand Inquisitor, Fourth Sister concurred with Fifth Brother concerning Reva's obsessive search for Kenobi. After the Jedi was tracked in Mapuzo, Fourth Sister accompanied Vader in his search of the planet.
